title: AI SDK Identifiers
description: Identifiers accepted for AI SDKs. An AI SDK has no user agent of its own because it wraps a caller-supplied client. It reports a package name and a language in the $ld:ai:sdk:info custom event instead. The name is not unique across SDKs, so each name is paired with every language the SDK declares.

AISDKIdentifier.description: One (name, language) pair accepted for an AI SDK. Historical names are retained so that older deployments still resolve.

name.description: The value reported as aiSdkName. This is the package name, for example '@launchdarkly/server-sdk-ai'.

language.description: The value reported as aiSdkLanguage, for example 'python'. Derived by lowercasing a language the SDK declares, so it may contain characters such as '+' or '#' (for example 'c++', 'c#').
